name: Coffee & Tea
description: Coffee and tea word search puzzles are built for a quiet cup — brew, aroma, chamomile, biscuit, mug, blend and steam — without café chain names. Free online for adults and seniors, with easy, medium, hard and large-print grids. No timer, no account and no brand logos: just the gentle vocabulary of kettles and afternoon pauses. Pairs naturally with Breakfast, Kitchen, Food and Desserts. If letters feel small, start in large print. New to the site? See how to play, then settle in as the kettle boils.
